cases.criteria: A README for a small Python command-line tool named greet. It should describe it as a Python CLI, and include installation and usage sections. It must not claim the project is a web app or uses a database.

A README for a small Node.js library published as an npm package (slugify-lite). It should mention npm install and how to import and use the library, with a usage section. It must not claim the project is written in Python.
